p6 roles: 'reader' removed; roles are now owner + other, because he redeemed (uddhṛtā) the book from a faithless person ([śra]ddhāhīnajanasya hastapatitā)
p1: removed the title 'rājñi', which is only the locative of rājan; used 'rājan' instead

Pakṣa: 'himābhā' gives śukla only tentatively, so this is flagged in notes

date.as_written: पञ्चचिंसाधिके ऽब्दे शततमप्रशते चैत्रमासे हिमाभा । विख्याते ऽस्मिन् दशम्यान्दनिंजरिपुगुरौ वासरे

purpose: Merit of the redemption transferred to his mother, father and all beings (second colophon)
notes: Main colophon (verse): the year is NS 135 = 1015 CE, as Bendall gives it. Caitra, daśamī. 'danujaripuguru' means Bṛhaspati, i.e. Thursday. Śukla pakṣa is inferred from 'himābhā' ('moon-bright') and is tentative. The colophon was written during the joint rule of Bhojadeva and Rudradeva, with Lakṣmīkāmadeva holding half the kingdom. The scribe Sujatabhadra (probably Sujātabhadra) copied it in the Śrī-Lhaṃ-vihāra of Nepālamaṇḍala. 'तपसीरखुसागरे' is corrupt; 'खुधीः' is probably सुधीः. Second colophon, added in a later hooked hand: dvitīye śatasya gatavati + pañcāsatā navamāñcitena = NS 259 (= c. 1139 CE), Kārtika (probably śukla) 5, under Mānadeva. In it someone redeemed the book from a faithless person ([śra]ddhāhīna-jana). The name 'कर्तुणपूर्वण वज्रिण' is taken as karuṇāpūrveṇa vajriṇā = Karuṇāvajra; this reading is uncertain. Only the original date is entered in the date fields.
